roles.description: Architecting and delivering enterprise-scale, serverless cloud solutions, platform engineering, and modern CI/CD automation for regulated UK healthcare systems.
highlights: Architected and delivered scalable, serverless AWS solutions to support high-volume healthcare data ingestion and analytics workloads, leveraging services including Amazon DynamoDB, AWS Lambda and Amazon S3 to ensure high availability and low-latency processing for critical UK healthcare systems.

Acted as Data Architect for serverless platforms, improving NoSQL data models in Amazon DynamoDB, optimising query performance, data access patterns, and cost efficiency for large-scale, event-driven applications.

Led the end-to-end migration of complex enterprise CI/CD pipelines from GitLab to GitHub, redesigning workflows using GitHub Actions to improve deployment consistency, reduce build times, and enhance developer experience.

Directed a cross-functional DevOps team responsible for platform reliability, security, and continuous delivery, embedding best practices across infrastructure management, incident response, and automated deployment strategies.

Designed and implemented Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, standardising cloud provisioning, improving environment consistency, and enabling repeatable, auditable deployments across multiple environments.
Led initiative to improve IaC module reusability and collaboration across multiple teams and projects, ensuring DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) and alignment with best practices.

Enhanced CI/CD maturity by introducing automated testing, deployment gating, and workflow optimisation through GitHub Actions, increasing release frequency while reducing risk in production environments.

Conducted AWS Well-Architected Framework reviews, identifying risks across security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimisation, and operational excellence pillars, and delivered actionable remediation roadmaps to senior stakeholders.

Drove cloud cost optimisation initiatives, analysing usage patterns and implementing right-sizing, storage lifecycle policies, and serverless optimisation strategies, resulting in measurable cost reductions across the platform.

Ensured platform security and compliance within a healthcare context, leveraging services such as Amazon Inspector, GuardDuty and Security Hub and aligning solutions with organisational and UK data governance requirements, including secure handling of sensitive patient data and adherence to least privilege access principles.

Provided technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and architects, supporting AWS certification pathways and upskilling teams in serverless architecture, Terraform, and cloud-native best practices.
Acted as a key technical stakeholder interface, translating complex architectural concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

roles.description: Led concurrent enterprise AWS cloud transformation programmes, landing zone architectures, large-scale migrations, and practice capability growth.
highlights: Led multiple concurrent AWS transformation programmes, providing architectural oversight and technical leadership across cross-functional teams of Cloud Architects and DevOps Engineers, delivering complex cloud solutions for enterprise customers.

Defined and governed cloud architecture strategy across customer engagements, ensuring alignment with AWS best practices, organisational objectives, and long-term scalability, security, and cost optimisation goals.

Directed the design and implementation of AWS platforms across both greenfield and brownfield environments, establishing robust, scalable, and secure cloud foundations tailored to diverse customer requirements.

Designed and led the implementation of enterprise-grade AWS Landing Zones, incorporating multi-account strategies, identity and access management, networking, and security baselines aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework and industry best practices.

Conducted detailed workload assessments across on-premises and existing cloud environments, shaping migration strategies including rehost, replatform, and refactor approaches, and enabling effective right-sizing and optimisation.

Owned end-to-end cloud migration strategies, leading large-scale infrastructure and database migrations using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), ensuring minimal downtime and risk during transition.

Established and standardised Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD practices across engagements, leveraging Terraform, CloudFormation, and AWS CDK to enable automated, repeatable, and auditable cloud deployments.
Embedded DevSecOps principles across delivery teams, introducing automated security controls, compliance checks, and pipeline governance to improve security posture and reduce deployment risk.

Acted as a key contributor to pre-sales and business development activities, shaping cloud solutions, producing high-quality proposals, and delivering technical presentations to customers and senior stakeholders to secure new business opportunities.

Collaborated closely with AWS and internal partner development teams to define and execute strategies aligned to AWS Partner Programs, including the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), driving customer adoption and unlocking funding opportunities.
Served as a trusted advisor to customers, influencing architectural decisions and guiding cloud adoption journeys from initial strategy through to implementation and optimisation.

Mentored and developed engineers and architects across the practice, contributing to capability growth, certification achievement, and the establishment of cloud architecture best practices within the organisation.

roles.description: Architected, implemented, and operated high-traffic AWS infrastructure and SAP Hybris eCommerce platforms for major UK retail enterprises. (Also held: Technical Lead, Senior Engineer).
highlights: Led technical discovery engagements for a major UK retail client, working across engineering, support, and product teams to define cloud adoption strategies and shape scalable AWS-based solutions for a high-traffic eCommerce platform.

Architected, implemented, and operated AWS infrastructure within a managed service environment, supporting a large-scale SAP Hybris (now SAP Commerce Cloud) platform with stringent availability, performance, and scalability requirements.

Designed and optimised a highly available eCommerce architecture leveraging Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling, Amazon RDS, Amazon S3, and distributed caching layers, ensuring resilience during peak retail demand periods.
Led the database modernisation strategy, migrating from Amazon RDS to Amazon Aurora, improving performance, scalability, and operational efficiency while reducing database management overhead.
Delivered end-to-end migrations from on-premises environments to AWS, covering both application and data layers, and enabling increased agility and operational resilience for customer platforms.
Introduced and matured Infrastructure as Code practices using AWS CloudFormation and Terraform, enabling consistent, repeatable infrastructure deployments and reducing manual configuration effort.
Drove automation initiatives across infrastructure provisioning, security controls, and operational processes, improving service reliability and reducing time spent on repetitive operational tasks.
Applied deep technical expertise across AWS services including Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, and Amazon RDS to design event-driven and scalable application components.
Collaborated with distributed engineering teams to develop reusable solution accelerators, frameworks, and proof-of-concepts, improving delivery speed and standardisation across customer engagements.
Contributed to pre-sales and commercial activities, including pricing, solution design, and customer presentations, supporting the acquisition and expansion of customer engagements.
Acted as a key technical escalation point within the managed service, supporting complex incident resolution and continuous improvement of platform stability and performance.

roles.role: Smart M2M IT Systems Support Engineer
roles.description: Provided shift-based NOC technical support and incident response for the UK Smart Metering Network with a specialisation in Linux and Open Source Software (OSS).
highlights: Responsible for working as a member of a shift-based NOC, providing technical support and incident response for the UK Smart Metering Network with a specialisation in Linux and OSS.
Monitored mission-critical network systems, triaged telemetry anomalies, and maintained high availability across distributed IoT/M2M infrastructure.

roles.description: Delivered pre-sales technical expertise, architectural design, and implementation of complex web and application hosting solutions for enterprise clients. (Also held: Technical Account Manager, Managed Hosting Support Technician, Dedicated Hosting Support Engineer, VPS Hosting Support Technician).
highlights: Primarily responsible for providing pre-sales technical expertise, design and implementation of complex web and application hosting solutions for both new and existing enterprise level clients.
Designed and supported managed hosting architectures, high-availability dedicated clusters, virtual private servers (VPS), and enterprise storage systems.
Progressed through technical support tiers: VPS Hosting Support Technician, Dedicated Hosting Support Engineer, Managed Hosting Support Technician, and Technical Account Manager.
